name: Rotate Matrix
description: You are given a square matrix of integer numbers. Rotate it 90 degrees clockwise (see examples for clarification of rotation).
input_specification: The input consists of n lines ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 , n is not given explicitly). Each of the lines contains n space-separated integers; j -th integer in i -th line corresponds to matrix element m ij ( 1 ≤ m ij ≤ 100 ).
output_specification: Output the rotated matrix in the same format as the input.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
